Headaches from white wine are  [Highlight start] most often caused by **alcohol itself** [Highlight end] —which dilates blood vessels, acts as a diuretic, and slows alcohol metabolism—as well as personal migraine triggers or individual sensitivities rather than the compounds most famous in red wine. While white wine generally has far less quercetin and fewer tannins and histamines than red wine, it can still trigger headaches in sensitive people.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7nb5tGfFonSjquJNmtQ6FAT-rmhg79oUMgUrNIh9Kbtz2LPHbgrCwyHRBOaSjEciBuf9m0cZaRUZfPuK6i8EYQIg8YWtXCHtPgL-e_Nv5O_Zjn6gK5kTYCi2MddKSy8q6yO-BPhy)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX5wDq5uRNdVHZFzIP3FsXMd7ERwOzPv6eRvICwzF9VI5KZieRU5MHkRKDDCYsAkvT80IDBJ8wYmSUwJd5yqddETEYme637U_cw5-tZdVhjdt2oM9A-BArBtr_X1Sk0BEAoSUh02AEcMM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXClPspmjja6oDCqEFPNQKl83Bl6YFs25Lln4yZ_H0JnjopgRli2Izvasz7x722_n3PJ2d95efLR9j7QEwM4a8iWn6j7awVTRa1ZFyHvzwmnvdQSfXZNMbpS_Ms7f7QC1zCP-yWKU)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX3uqn90WsBsh4NqhTIDNT6ZL3a0EC6OigBE7CHVFvuzs_5sp40uLCSkBmxjbOv8gf13r2wACd56eVgPc1jj3h9oWpcS2qmn8ElWCxF4yZmopiSn-Rq44mh_LHYwxoWXO1Q9_yKULp)

### Common Culprits Behind White Wine Headaches

- **Alcohol and dehydration:** Alcohol widens blood vessels and increases fluid loss, contributing to throbbing headaches or hangovers. People with certain genetic variations in alcohol-metabolizing enzymes (such as ALDH2) can experience faster reactions from acetaldehyde buildup.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXClPspmjja6oDCqEFPNQKl83Bl6YFs25Lln4yZ_H0JnjopgRli2Izvasz7x722_n3PJ2d95efLR9j7QEwM4a8iWn6j7awVTRa1ZFyHvzwmnvdQSfXZNMbpS_Ms7f7QC1zCP-yWKU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX3uqn90WsBsh4NqhTIDNT6ZL3a0EC6OigBE7CHVFvuzs_5sp40uLCSkBmxjbOv8gf13r2wACd56eVgPc1jj3h9oWpcS2qmn8ElWCxF4yZmopiSn-Rq44mh_LHYwxoWXO1Q9_yKULp)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7nb5tGfFonSjquJNmtQ6FAT-rmhg79oUMgUrNIh9Kbtz2LPHbgrCwyHRBOaSjEciBuf9m0cZaRUZfPuK6i8EYQIg8YWtXCHtPgL-e_Nv5O_Zjn6gK5kTYCi2MddKSy8q6yO-BPhy)
- **Sulfites (less likely, but often blamed):** White wine typically contains higher levels of sulfites than red wine to prevent oxidation and spoilage. However, medical research generally finds sulfites are an unlikely primary cause of wine headaches for most people, tending instead to trigger breathing or allergy-like symptoms in sensitive individuals. Opinions on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXqtcixNmuDiQ19sZN2mAiHGJjCYcr0BGr3PheqGVhOpiPOEZQvD5CpEUkJu7iw1Y1HIjmSs4GO5Ra6qEgKccfHFt8TM7Py8Cey324HS0a-lTaiiYFFz7HbkUCkDFLBHxYeyzNPnCid1W1aD_-y6ZTgRPrLPDUwC5N5dw) differ on this topic, with some users blaming sulfites while others point to histamines or other triggers instead.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16JXHmcllYR2ZFwX2R3_7J2FAhGHABiXraeMvHhYi9adBNSTLK_MUeM_5TGQCsAWyjreiEKgBZWqtCsXKUGwenbNHdCRgoPCgO49LTP6eMFlaT0BBdszGane_ifstp06vqaKA93eW1CCCFkC5X8f-SU_GeSppgOo_GVnONHnCyyAp14-sfw7)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX5wDq5uRNdVHZFzIP3FsXMd7ERwOzPv6eRvICwzF9VI5KZieRU5MHkRKDDCYsAkvT80IDBJ8wYmSUwJd5yqddETEYme637U_cw5-tZdVhjdt2oM9A-BArBtr_X1Sk0BEAoSUh02AEcMM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF18u9J3I6sK5J6Z9fKPdhUUJCBJ30jHsl6if_sfeO78Q3zhmPq5DmGCvJkdMG-0ns_aFZwBUDkpZdJHr6TUflaYn-2CFhzm8oEQ0yPoENW1KwiEjb5fVX2hxcaVNadCL2gYGa2iyg2oDUVoGEQsFFWfuIBgRkZoU1nGrkDyjy1dBObTGuwTJ7o3nl1e25Z8klggnK1PU6AqNY2FZRpaUncOFfJ4ZvTjdhMzLxscEgpw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXGj_IEG3_QD0E4KvKwa6QpAt0XyND-YBt1qxuike4W_REZGLZLrzT4ruXEr5Y2fv4LKbkXEkuXrX556f3EpMMJlgymRD0Jw64LD42VfSnkQpnoAmcMJiNzdDFl4V7vY5MFw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXqtcixNmuDiQ19sZN2mAiHGJjCYcr0BGr3PheqGVhOpiPOEZQvD5CpEUkJu7iw1Y1HIjmSs4GO5Ra6qEgKccfHFt8TM7Py8Cey324HS0a-lTaiiYFFz7HbkUCkDFLBHxYeyzNPnCid1W1aD_-y6ZTgRPrLPDUwC5N5dw)
- **Histamines, tyramine, and other wine compounds:** White wine usually has lower histamine levels than red wine, though trace amounts or other compounds like tyramine can still bother people prone to migraines or histamine intolerance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX5wDq5uRNdVHZFzIP3FsXMd7ERwOzPv6eRvICwzF9VI5KZieRU5MHkRKDDCYsAkvT80IDBJ8wYmSUwJd5yqddETEYme637U_cw5-tZdVhjdt2oM9A-BArBtr_X1Sk0BEAoSUh02AEcMM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXqtcixNmuDiQ19sZN2mAiHGJjCYcr0BGr3PheqGVhOpiPOEZQvD5CpEUkJu7iw1Y1HIjmSs4GO5Ra6qEgKccfHFt8TM7Py8Cey324HS0a-lTaiiYFFz7HbkUCkDFLBHxYeyzNPnCid1W1aD_-y6ZTgRPrLPDUwC5N5dw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF19maTJAYDWFIilRD4fyZFDPVPgbqUCjMljXQPen24-XEQgTAyOSmHykjJbCyjMQxdRySq7kHnzAiAXqEzPFKYSJsROekZsSGvb5odAIaZeP2O2dvmsWacRAHCk-sndfzCdMF8ibLtV5yskPbuFUV9l9SWMSDeAYhw9oKSxvrDhpZK4mS58eK1Uk9K3w)
- **Sugar and extra triggers:** Sweeter wines, drinking on an empty stomach, lack of sleep, stress, or an underlying migraine tendency can make a headache more likely.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF1yhxi6Lo8OzN1ZTm9t3iXJG6uPiRb3vN2o5freKY9JbOG5-V3f8h4WimG1jNGmtcGCirxeiJGoVL3DNzh-cGVVMfPFk6tTnj2EdSS62KYAm51kmSB793W_d_kaB4GO2MlaR9ffT_p9RtHve3mmXj3awo3OM5ZgEUzyt7VW5icyQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16JXHmcllYR2ZFwX2R3_7J2FAhGHABiXraeMvHhYi9adBNSTLK_MUeM_5TGQCsAWyjreiEKgBZWqtCsXKUGwenbNHdCRgoPCgO49LTP6eMFlaT0BBdszGane_ifstp06vqaKA93eW1CCCFkC5X8f-SU_GeSppgOo_GVnONHnCyyAp14-sfw7)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXClPspmjja6oDCqEFPNQKl83Bl6YFs25Lln4yZ_H0JnjopgRli2Izvasz7x722_n3PJ2d95efLR9j7QEwM4a8iWn6j7awVTRa1ZFyHvzwmnvdQSfXZNMbpS_Ms7f7QC1zCP-yWKU)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX3uqn90WsBsh4NqhTIDNT6ZL3a0EC6OigBE7CHVFvuzs_5sp40uLCSkBmxjbOv8gf13r2wACd56eVgPc1jj3h9oWpcS2qmn8ElWCxF4yZmopiSn-Rq44mh_LHYwxoWXO1Q9_yKULp)

### Ways to Help Prevent Them

- **Pace and hydrate:** Drink a glass of water alongside your wine and keep portions moderate.
- **Eat first:** Having a meal or snack helps slow alcohol absorption and supports blood sugar.
- **Pick lower-ABV, drier styles:** Wines with lower alcohol content and less residual sugar are often easier to tolerate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX3uqn90WsBsh4NqhTIDNT6ZL3a0EC6OigBE7CHVFvuzs_5sp40uLCSkBmxjbOv8gf13r2wACd56eVgPc1jj3h9oWpcS2qmn8ElWCxF4yZmopiSn-Rq44mh_LHYwxoWXO1Q9_yKULp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF1yhxi6Lo8OzN1ZTm9t3iXJG6uPiRb3vN2o5freKY9JbOG5-V3f8h4WimG1jNGmtcGCirxeiJGoVL3DNzh-cGVVMfPFk6tTnj2EdSS62KYAm51kmSB793W_d_kaB4GO2MlaR9ffT_p9RtHve3mmXj3awo3OM5ZgEUzyt7VW5icyQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXClPspmjja6oDCqEFPNQKl83Bl6YFs25Lln4yZ_H0JnjopgRli2Izvasz7x722_n3PJ2d95efLR9j7QEwM4a8iWn6j7awVTRa1ZFyHvzwmnvdQSfXZNMbpS_Ms7f7QC1zCP-yWKU)

For more details on wine triggers and prevention, see [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7nb5tGfFonSjquJNmtQ6FAT-rmhg79oUMgUrNIh9Kbtz2LPHbgrCwyHRBOaSjEciBuf9m0cZaRUZfPuK6i8EYQIg8YWtXCHtPgL-e_Nv5O_Zjn6gK5kTYCi2MddKSy8q6yO-BPhy) and [The Splendid Table](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16JXHmcllYR2ZFwX2R3_7J2FAhGHABiXraeMvHhYi9adBNSTLK_MUeM_5TGQCsAWyjreiEKgBZWqtCsXKUGwenbNHdCRgoPCgO49LTP6eMFlaT0BBdszGane_ifstp06vqaKA93eW1CCCFkC5X8f-SU_GeSppgOo_GVnONHnCyyAp14-sfw7).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7nb5tGfFonSjquJNmtQ6FAT-rmhg79oUMgUrNIh9Kbtz2LPHbgrCwyHRBOaSjEciBuf9m0cZaRUZfPuK6i8EYQIg8YWtXCHtPgL-e_Nv5O_Zjn6gK5kTYCi2MddKSy8q6yO-BPhy)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16JXHmcllYR2ZFwX2R3_7J2FAhGHABiXraeMvHhYi9adBNSTLK_MUeM_5TGQCsAWyjreiEKgBZWqtCsXKUGwenbNHdCRgoPCgO49LTP6eMFlaT0BBdszGane_ifstp06vqaKA93eW1CCCFkC5X8f-SU_GeSppgOo_GVnONHnCyyAp14-sfw7)If you'd like to narrow this down, share a bit more context:

- Do your headaches start **right away** (within minutes or a glass) or **the next morning**?
- Do you get **other symptoms** (like flushing, congestion, nausea, or light sensitivity) or **migraines**?
- Do **other alcohols** or **sulfite-rich foods** (like dried fruit) cause similar reactions?

items.markdown:
- **Pace and hydrate:** Drink a glass of water alongside your wine and keep portions moderate.
- **Eat first:** Having a meal or snack helps slow alcohol absorption and supports blood sugar.

items.markdown:
If you'd like to narrow this down, share a bit more context:

- Do your headaches start **right away** (within minutes or a glass) or **the next morning**?
- Do you get **other symptoms** (like flushing, congestion, nausea, or light sensitivity) or **migraines**?
- Do **other alcohols** or **sulfite-rich foods** (like dried fruit) cause similar reactions?
